filter_rules.bucket_kstar: finite Polymarket boundary with first clean post-warmup PM survival closest to 0.5
filter_rules.point_kstar: market-defined point_above threshold with first post-warmup YES price closest to 0.5

known_caveats: No external BTC/ETH event-start index series is available in the repository yet; initial_k_star_moneyness is therefore null.
Bucket-event K* currently uses an ex-ante Polymarket-implied fallback rather than a spot-index ATM boundary.
Point-threshold events contain multiple market-defined thresholds; the current rule picks the least saturated threshold near 0.5 at the first post-warmup observation.
